MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The repair supplies loosely fit my recent household upkeep, but none addressed a specific need strongly enough for me to choose it now.",
    "The woodworking adhesive and hardware assortment connected broadly with my construction purchases, though neither matched the fastening work those purchases suggest."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Framing nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors serve particular fastening jobs; locking nuts need matching bolts, so they are not interchangeable next purchases for me.",
    "Temperature measurement, precision measuring, metal cutting, and electrical insulation each require a task or tool need that my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "Specialty woodturning glue and wet-surface epoxy solve problems I have not indicated, while the bulk tape and glue packs exceed any current need I can identify."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying construction fasteners seems to have been treated as interest in almost any workshop or repair supply.",
    "My purchases of large packs of nails and screws seem to have been extended to bulk adhesives and tape, even though quantity needs depend on the specific job."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The intended material, dimensions, and fastening method matter more to me than simply being another piece of hardware.",
    "My vacuum bag purchase points to a specific replacement fit, which is different from a general appetite for maintenance supplies.",
    "I choose supplies when they meet a concrete need; a loosely related product is not enough to make me buy it now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my construction and household upkeep interests, but stretched them into unrelated tools and repair supplies without enough evidence of a current need."
}
